mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room_members (room_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{userId}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT , NULL AS nickname FROM room_members m WHERE m.room_id = #{roomId} AND m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.left_at IS NULL
